subject.title: fix(streaming): preserve paragraph separators across block-streamed deliveries [AI-assisted]

question: Should the durable block-streaming contract use in-band separator text, explicit boundary metadata, or an accepted partial common-case repair for paragraph seams near maxChars?
rationale: The bug is source-proven and this PR is close for common cases, but the remaining near-limit case requires choosing the streaming payload contract rather than making a narrow mechanical edit.

options.title: Require a complete shared fix
options.body: Consolidate one candidate PR and require preservation for both in-budget and near-maxChars paragraph splits before merge.

options.title: Adopt explicit boundary metadata
options.body: Ask the contributor to carry paragraph/newline/hard-split seam metadata through chunker, subscriber, and coalescer if text-only chunks cannot satisfy all invariants.

options.title: Accept a partial repair
options.body: Land the common-case text-only improvement knowingly and leave the near-maxChars boundary documented on the canonical issue as remaining work.

recommendation.title: Require a complete shared fix
recommendation.body: Consolidate one candidate PR and require preservation for both in-budget and near-maxChars paragraph splits before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the clearest coalescer and streaming-contract history among the likely owners.
